answer: Each identity's transactions must form an unbroken nonce sequence with no gaps, and a gap freezes the identity until it is repaired. The knoll chain is checked at intake, gaps appear in jetty, and velvet seals the repaired sequence, which the replay verifies against each signature. Cloning a key into 18 hands breaks the sequence because two signers race the same nonce, thus a shared-credential farm convicts itself on the first collision. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
